cells.detail: SMARTS illustrates why market-abuse detection, alerting and investigation are distinct from an oracle price or an immutable transaction log.

cells.text: Cross-market manipulation monitoring and alert workflow
cells.note: Role in the SEC order: supporting layer

cells.text: Nasdaq and Payward expanded their relationship on September 10 with a market-surveillance agreement covering crypto, equities and tokenized equities alongside NET framework work.
cells.detail: Where the proof stops: An agreement to adopt surveillance technology is not an operating alert, completed deployment, regulatory-reporting receipt or halt authority.

items: Data + market controls · Surveillance + halts: Surveillance analytics fill a separate sublayer from price formation and reporting.
Interoperability + services · API / integration: The system depends on complete venue, reference-market and participant data feeds.

cells.text: Surveillance software does not itself halt a market, adjudicate misconduct, create regulatory reports, operate the venue or guarantee complete data coverage.
cells.note: Watch: Named deployment, data feeds, alert scenarios, human escalation, halt authority, retention, false-positive review and incident receipts.
